sentences.text: EMI means the equated monthly instalment payable towards principal and interest, and monthly intervals are called EMIs.
An in-force home-loan document states an EMI amount of ₹21,696 and 240 monthly instalments for that loan.
The evidence does not provide a calculation formula or a product-specific schedule for an EMI on Rs 10,00,000 at 9% per annum for 0 months.
